Read input: rtlpp_10536_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_10536(
    input clk,
    input flash,
    input [31:0] Hexs,
    input [7:0] LES,
    input [7:0] point,
    input rst,
    input Start,
    input SW0,
    output seg_clk,
    output seg_clrn,
    output SEG_PEN,
    output seg_sout
);
    
    wire [63:0] XLXN_14;
    wire [63:0] XLXN_15;
    wire [63:0] XLXN_16;

    // Embedded logic from P2S
    reg [63:0] shift_reg;
    reg seg_clk_reg;
    reg seg_clrn_reg;
    assign seg_clk = seg_clk_reg;
    assign seg_clrn = seg_clrn_reg;
    assign seg_sout = shift_reg[63];

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            shift_reg <= 64'b0;
            seg_clk_reg <= 1'b0;
            seg_clrn_reg <= 1'b0;
        end else if (Start) begin
            shift_reg <= XLXN_14;
            seg_clk_reg <= ~seg_clk_reg;
            seg_clrn_reg <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            shift_reg <= {shift_reg[62:0], 1'b0};
            seg_clk_reg <= ~seg_clk_reg;
        end
    end

    // Embedded logic from HexTo8SEG8
    reg [63:0] SEG_TXT;
    always @(*) begin
        integer i;
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
            if (flash)
                SEG_TXT[(i*8)+7 -: 8] = {LES[i], Hexs[(i*4)+3 -: 4], point[i]};
            else
                SEG_TXT[(i*8)+7 -: 8] = {1'b0, Hexs[(i*4)+3 -: 4], point[i]};
        end
    end

    assign XLXN_16 = SEG_TXT;

    // Embedded logic from MUX2T1_64
    assign XLXN_14 = SW0 ? XLXN_16 : XLXN_15;

    // Embedded logic from SSeg_map
    reg [63:0] Seg_map;
    always @(*) begin
        integer j;
        for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin
            Seg_map[(j*8)+7 -: 8] = Hexs[j*4 +: 4] << 4 | Hexs[j*4 +: 4];
        end
    end

    assign XLXN_15 = Seg_map;

endmodule
